title: [DEV] 3.3.0-dev-e doesn't broadcast data to xdrip
body: I updated to 3.3.0-dev-e today (Build 6f3e9372ef) and noticed that bg-values. smbs and the like are no longer being broadcasted over to xdrip. Haven't changed any settings.

comments.body: It works for me. Are you sure all settings are correct? Build is now dev-f :)
Yes since I haven't changed any settings, just updated aaps with the newer dev version and broadcast stopped working. I'll try dev-f tomorrow and will get back to you thanks
I activated xDrip sync  yesterday. I can see basal rendering in xDrip isn't updated, but bg, treatments and profile are synced. Not sure if it takes longer time for basal rendering to work.
